isModuleType(uint256).details: Returns boolean value if module is a certain type

params.moduleTypeId: the module type ID according the ERC-7579 spec MUST return true if the module is of the given type and false otherwise

isValidSignatureWithSender(address,bytes.details: See {IERC7579Validator-isValidSignatureWithSender}. Ignores the `sender` parameter and validates using {_rawERC7579Validation}. Consider overriding this function to implement custom validation logic based on the original sender.

onInstall(bytes).details: Sets up the module's initial configuration when installed by an account. The `data` parameter should contain the signer address (20 bytes minimum). If the account doesn't already have a signer configured, the first 20 bytes of `data` will be used as the authorized signer address. See {_extractSigner} for more details about the encoding. Requirements: * The `data` must be at least 20 bytes. Reverts with {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorInvalidSignerLength} if not. * The `data` must contain a valid signer address. Reverts with {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorInvalidSigner} if not. * The `account` must have no signer installed. Reverts with {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorAlreadyInstalled} if not. Emits a {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorSignerSet} event if the signer is set.

onUninstall(bytes).details: Cleans up the module's configuration when uninstalled from an account. Removes the authorized signer for the calling account. If the account has a configured signer, it will be cleared. If no signer is configured, this function will behave as a no-op. Emits a {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorSignerSet} event if the signer is cleared.

setSigner(address,address).details: Sets the signer for the specified account. Requirements: * The `newSigner` must not be the zero address. * The caller must be the specified account. Emits a {ERC7579ECDSAValidatorSignerSet} event.

signer(address).details: Returns the authorized signer for the specified account.

params.userOpHash: the hash of the ERC-4337 PackedUserOperation MUST validate that the signature is a valid signature of the userOpHash SHOULD return ERC-4337's SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (and not revert) on signature mismatch See {IAccount-validateUserOp} for additional information on the return value
